prompts.guitarra:
Use case: identity-preserve complete character poses. Input is a PRECISE POSE GUIDE, not final art. It shows 18 identical approved guitarist bodies without the fretting arm; white/magenta crosses mark where the CENTER OF THE FRETTING HAND must go. Draw a COMPLETE NATURAL CONNECTED LEFT ARM in every cell, keeping EVERYTHING else unchanged. Output transparent PNG with the EXACT same THREE columns SIX rows, 18 square cells, overall aspect1:2 (prefer1536x3072). Same fixed character/head/guitar registration and scale.
Preserve the guitarist's exact face, magenta forehead eye and monocle, tied hair/braid, beard/chin plate and substantial burgundy jacket. His anatomical RIGHT picking arm is already correct and must stay as drawn. Add anatomical LEFT/image-RIGHT fretting arm attached naturally to right shoulder: rounded upper sleeve with body volume, a visibly bent elbow BELOW the guitar neck, sturdy thick cylindrical forearm, normal wrist and fully formed natural hand with five fingers curling around the neck. The arm must look like a real filled three-dimensional limb in a cloth sleeve, matching the MASS of the picking arm. NOT a flat ribbon, sheet of paper, thin pipe, stretched cutout or unnaturally straight long forearm. No thin pancake or detached hand. Draw the entire arm anatomically for EACH pose rather than warping one arm.
In EACH CELL, hand palm/fingers centered exactly on the marked cross, with fingers wrapping onto the frets just above it. REMOVE ALL crosses/circles/guides in final image. Elbow stays lower and to the right of the hand, shoulder stays fixed. Pose1 leftmost green fret, next progressively along neck in half-fret increments, pose9 orange; repeat for the lower9 sprites with picking hand down already in guide. First9 cells preserve raised picking hand, last9 preserve downstroke hand. Maintain same natural arm thickness across all18.
Keep torso and both shoulders steady, no shrinkage or stretching, no extra arms/hands or finger fragments. Do not change instruments, logo, button positions or add effects. All five fret buttons remain visible and DARK/unlit; code later applies lights. Transparent alpha ZERO background, no glow backdrop, no grid/text/watermarks, each complete waist-up sprite inside its own square with gutter. This corrects paper-flat arms: convincing rounded arm volume and a real elbow bend are the highest priority, while placing the hand exactly at the cross.
prompts.baixo:
Use case: identity-preserve complete musician pose illustration. The input is a precise 18-cell POSE GUIDE: approved bassist body without fretting arm, white/magenta target cross indicating center of fretting hand. Generate COMPLETE NATURAL anatomically connected LEFT fretting arms in all cells, preserving everything else. Output transparent PNG same THREE columns SIX rows, 18 SQUARE cells, aspect1:2 (prefer1536x3072).
Preserve exact woman's face, turquoise eye, pink monocle/star makeup, freckles, septum piercing, brown/white/pink hair and side bun, infinity choker, purple black cyberpunk jacket, fingerless gloves and bass. Same face/body/instrument position and scale in every frame. Keep existing RIGHT picking hand unchanged. First9 guide cells have picking hand raised, last9 picking hand lowered.
In each cell draw a substantial rounded LEFT upper arm with jacket sleeve, elbow bent DOWN BELOW THE BASS NECK, fully formed thick forearm in sleeve, normal gloved wrist and natural five-finger gripping hand centered EXACTLY ON THAT CELL'S CROSS, fingertips curling over the neck just above. Each arm must have believable cloth volume and lighting and the same overall mass as her picking arm. Do NOT draw a thin flat strip, paper ribbon, stretched-cutout arm, tiny shrunken forearm, disconnected wrist or stiff horizontal tube. The elbow belongs below the hand and curves naturally from shoulder to fingertips. Draw the WHOLE arm for each pose with natural anatomy, not by distorting a shared limb.
First9 progress from first/green fret to final/orange in nine half-fret steps; last9 repeat with picking hand down. Cross positions are exact placement guides; REMOVE ALL crosses/circles in final. Keep natural arm length, thickness and shoulder attachment stable across every pose; no extra arms, elbows or hands. Keep all five dark/unlit fret buttons visible; precise binary lights added later by code. Do not change guitar shape, outfit, face, camera, crop or limb number. True alpha ZERO empty background/gutters, no scenery, halo, gradient, text or grid. Highest priority: NATURAL rounded connected anatomy rather than paper-flat arms, with the hand gripping the guided fret location.
